title: MooseMobs
description: Overhaul the Mobs in your Minecraft world with Moosified Whimsey!
body:
# You're Telling Me a Moose Made these Mobs?
Yes! A Cosmic Moose to be exact! With this pack I wanted to extend my art style from the rest of my packs into the design of Minecraft's Mobs. Currently covering all hostile mobs, villagers, and a few others, this pack stays true to a Vanilla feel with a bit more style and whimsey. If you enjoy my packs, please join the discord server and give feedback so I can improve them! 
### Key Features
- Villagers and Babies retextured with new biome outfits inspired by real world cultures.
- Illagers overhauled with a consistent color scheme, and less derpy ravagers.
- Redesigned piglins and hoglins 
- Minecraft Dungeons 2 inspired redesign of the Warden
- Redesigned Sniffer (snifflet coming in a future update)
- Golden Allay recolor
- Redesigned spiders: standard spiders redesigned to look like a wolf spider and the cave spider is redesigned to look like a jumping spider pulling its color palette from its native sulfur caves biome.
- Several more Moosified Mobs
- Fresh Animations support with addon.

### Upcoming Features
- Villager profession outfit redesigns
- Updated passive mobs

### Other Packs Made By a Moose
If you like my work and want to get the full MooseCraft experience, check out my resource packs: [Mooseblocks](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mooseblocks), [Moose UI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mooseui), [Moose Items](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/moose-items), and [MooseGen](https://modrinth.com/datapack/moose-gen)! All of the gallery screenshots use these packs!
